notes: Explore idea: Wagner-Whitin dynamic lot sizing as an order calendar on top of the back-tested forecast, with Silver-Meal / POQ / lot-for-lot priced on the same forecast. Verified against brute force (400 seeded cases), heuristics never below exact (300 cases), page run in Chromium (no console errors, no 375px overflow). Benchmark (invented, lotsize-bench.mjs): SM mean +1.7-2.3% (worst 26%), POQ +1.5-13% (worst 96%), L4L +43-72%. Next: quantity-discount (price-break) lot sizing. Local checks: node --test 50 pass; run_venture_tests ok; clauses.mjs ok; post frontmatter/links/similarity ok.
